content: संस्कृत {%<ab>p. p.</ab>%} .²1 Made perfect, refined, polished, cultivated. .²2 Artificially made, highly wrought, carefully or accurately formed, elaborated. .²3 Made ready, dressed, prepared; cooked. .²4 Consecrated, hallowed; संस्कृतश्चापि रामेण जगाम गतिमुत्तमाम् <ls>Rām. 4. 57. 11</ls>. .²5 Initiated into worldly life, married. .²6 Cleansed, purified. .²7 Adorned, decorated. .²8 Excellent, best. .{@-तः@} .²1 A word formed regularly according to the rules of grammar, a regular derivative. .²2 A man of any one of the first three castes over whom all the purificatory rites have been performed. .²3 A learned man. .{@-तम्@} .²1 Refined or highly polished speech, the Sanskṛt language; संस्कृतं नाम दैवी वागन्वाख्याता महर्षिभिः <ls>Kāv. 1. 33</ls>. .²2 A sacred usage. .²3 An offering, oblation (mostly Vedic).
